seam.supportsDeviceMultipolePotential: ROCm only: device multipole potential for the host SCF loop; CUDA covers it inside the resident loop (GPU_PARITY_CUDA_ROCM.md, table B item 4)
seam.supportsDeviceSolvationGfn1: ROCm takes GFN1 with solvent on the resident loop, CUDA keeps it on its host-driven loop (GPU_PARITY_CUDA_ROCM.md, table A)

traits.has_device_schur: ROCm false by design: the device Schur step has its own switch rocm_device_schur (GPU_PARITY_CUDA_ROCM.md, table A)
traits.has_multi_gpu_split: gap: no multi-GPU EEQ split on ROCm (GPU_PARITY_CUDA_ROCM.md, table A)
traits.default_eeq_cpu_fragment_threshold: ROCm keeps 16, the CPU fragment route is about 3x faster than the dense device route at 197 atoms and 39 fragments (ROCM_RESIDENT_LOOP_WP.md)
